titulo: The keys have one home. A hook
caption:
The keys have one home. A hook

The keys have one home in our house, and it is a hook. Nobody has hunted for them in years.

A hook costs one second at the door and saves the search when you are already late.

For whoever hangs the keys the second they walk in.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a small wooden board and a single hook on the right. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks in from the left, its eyes go wide, it leans and a ring of two keys flies over in an arc and lands on the hook, swinging. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me hanging the keys the second I'm in.
